texts.full_text: studies have suggested that the Lewis phenotype is associated with susceptibility to infection by *Norovirus*^[@CR30]^, *Rotavirus*^[@CR31]^ and *Helicobacter pylori*^[@CR32]^. The Lewis-negative phenotype is resistant to norovirus (GI) and rotavirus (P8), which are the leading causes of acute gastroenteritis in children worldwide. According to a previous report, the Lewis-negative phenotype varies from 7% (Asians) or 8% (Europeans) to 19% (Africans)^[@CR21]^. Our results showed that the frequencies of the Lewis-negative phenotype were 12% (Sindhi) and 22.93% (Punjabi). Thus, a stable proportion of the Lewis-negative phenotype is maintained under long-term natural selection. The reason may be associated with microorganism infection, possibly related to a protective strategy against widespread disease. In the past, it was relatively difficult to accurately classify Lewis phenotypes using the haemagglutination test in medico-legal investigations. This method only works for whole blood samples, not for special materials such as body fluid, hair, and bloodstains that are commonly found at crime scenes. However, in this study, we successfully typed the Lewis phenotype using bloodstain samples. In conclusion, multiple sequence variations and a wide variety of alleles, including eleven novel alleles of *FUT3*, were identified by systematic sequencing analysis in Punjabi and Sindhi populations. These populations were not previously studied in reference to *FUT3*, and our present study revealed that the Sindhi and Punjabi populations are a mixture of South Asian and Caucasian ancestry. Thus, a genetically better understanding of the origins of these two ethnic groups is presented in this research. texts.full_text: Defendants. MEMORANDUM & ORDER ON RESTITUTION JACK B. WEINSTEIN, Senior District Judge: Introduction: The issue before the court is whether restitution should be ordered under the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act of 1986 ("MVRA"), and if so, in what amount for each defendant convicted. The government has requested that defendants Joseph Agate et al., make full or partial payments to various victims as a result of their criminal activities. Legal Framework: The MVRA requires courts to order restitution "to the extent agreed by parties, in favor of certain enumerated categories of victims." 18 U.S.C §3664(f)(I). The statute provides a list of factors for consideration when determining whether and how much compensation should be awarded: - Financial resources; - Financial needs/earning ability; - Amounts owed in restitution to other victims, etc.; 18 U.S.C §3664(e). Defendants' Objections: The defendants argue that they lack the financial means to pay significant amounts of compensation and contest certain victim claims as unrelated or overstated. Each defendant’s ability must be evaluated individually, considering their personal circumstances including income sources, assets available for liquidation without causing undue hardship on dependents (if any), future earning potential based upon age/health conditions etc., alongside the nature of criminal activity leading to restitution request(s). Court's Analysis: The court has reviewed submissions from both parties and finds that while some claims may be overstated or lack sufficient evidentiary support, there is a substantial basis for ordering partial compensation in many cases. The financial resources of each defendant vary widely; therefore the amounts ordered will reflect this disparity ensuring fairness without imposing an undue burden on any individual involved herein. Order: 1) Joseph Agate: Ordered to pay $50,000 in restitution over a period of 36 months with monthly payments not exceeding his ability as determined by the Probation Department; 2) [Additional orders for each defendant will be detailed similarly based on individual financial assessments and victim claims]. Conclusion: Restitutions

The intention was to identify which factors influence the effectiveness of airline marketing conducted via YouTube an as well as the way in which they do it. Analysis of selected data was facilitated by social media analytics tool SocialBakers, content analyses and a correlation analysis of YouTube metrics, selected on the base of previous research results. The research data were collected twice during the year 2017 in order to reflect changes over time. Research results showed that FSCs build their YouTube channels more systematically than LCCs. FSCs offer a substantially wider range of video topics and often sort out topics of their videos in a more detailed way. Regarding the basic metrics of YouTube channels (total number of views, number of subscribers), FSCs surpass LCCs significantly. One reason for their much higher rate of views is the fact that FSCs use celebrities more frequently, and frequently they offer high-quality impression/relationship airline presentation.
